content.description:
In 2060, a little scientist accompanied by his assistants, tested one of his crazy experiments, an electric seaplane built with recycled plastic. Despite several years of experience and above-average intelligence, his out-of-the-box ideas had a low success rate and this time was no different... Mr. Carrot didn't tighten a very important screw of one of the wings of the seaplane, and ended up crashing.

To Mr. Carrot's surprise, he had landed on a huge island, careless and with little life. Unable to get out of there, he built a laboratory on the island for years, with the aim of with all his crazy experiments, making those lands sustainable, having given them the name of EcoLands.

In short, EcoLands is a kind of ecological metaverse on the Cardano Network, aiming to be a fully community driven project with the ability to become profitable for its members.

All the details can be found here in the FAQs and other information channels.
